title: Exact decimal string
description: The repo's carrier for every exact number. A plain (non-exponent) decimal literal in a JSON string: '0.1', '-12.3400', '1000000000000'. Layers that MUST use it: money, price, quantity, percentage and ratio (see the sibling files). NEVER a JSON number: binary64 silently loses precision on 1e12-scale values and on money sums, which is why the repo states the rule in four packages. Canonical implementations: apps/executor/internal/decimal/decimal.go (Parse/MustParse/Add/Sub/Mul/Quo/Cmp/Trim, math/big Rat; doc: 'exact decimal string arithmetic for money and quantity ... never float64 in financial paths'); apps/api/internal/finance/{ledger,portfolio,transactions,treasury}/decimal.go (big.Rat trios); apps/api/internal/markets/instruments/rounding.go (mant*10^-scale grid math). Absence rule: the EMPTY STRING or an omitted key means 'not reported by the source', never zero and never a borrowed value (apps/api/internal/markets/overview/market.go Ticker doc). Do not append a unit to the string; the unit is named by the field (…_usd, …_pct).
